title: Partial-Knowledge Disclosure: a part-level evaluation of how language models handle partially covered questions
description:
An open evaluation, built on Inspect AI, of how language models behave when the reference material they are given covers only some parts of a multi-part question. Each part is scored separately, with a separate verdict for parts answered correctly from the material but with an added unsupported claim.

Includes the 60-case dataset, the evaluation code and judge prompt, hand labels, and per-run results with 95% bootstrap intervals.
